name: Extra Constellation Aspect
body:
You possess extra knowledge of constellation aspects.

Prerequisites: Minor Binding or Bind spirit class feature.

Benefit: You can bind one constellation aspect to a spirit, as the occultist class feature. An occultist who selects this feat can also bind multiple aspects to a single spirit, up to their maximum (one per spirit, plus one per time they select this feat).

Special: An occultist with the constellation aspects class feature may select this feat multiple times.
